hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Term Structure Slope and Reversal Overlay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Under equilibrium market conditions, implied volatility displays contango (90-day IV exceeds 30-day IV) to compensate option writers for horizon uncertainty. When near-term market panics strike, 30-day IV spikes above 90-day IV (backwardation), reflecting irrational retail and institutional overpaying for short-term downside put protection. Intra-industry ranking of term structure slope isolates equities whose volatility curve is anomalously steep, harvesting variance risk premia while hedging out systematic equity beta.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail to outperform when the VIX term structure collapses into prolonged flat regimes.

hypotheses.title: Intra-Industry Systematic Low-Beta Anomaly in Market Neutrality
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Leverage-constrained market participants disproportionately buy high-beta equities to amplify market exposure without leverage, leading to systematic overvaluation of high-beta stocks and persistent risk-adjusted outperformance of low-beta stocks (Betting Against Beta). Ranking inverted 60-day rolling SPY beta (-beta_last_60_days_spy) within industry groups captures quality resilience while minimizing tail risk and portfolio drawdowns.
confounders: Abrupt macroeconomic regime shifts and liquidity shocks
Sector rotation into cyclical high-beta equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Low-beta alpha delivers negative returns during extreme speculative liquidity surges.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Signal Diffusion and Spillover
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Information propagates sluggishly along complex inter-firm supply chain networks. Shocks experienced by major customer firms are reflected in customer stock prices immediately, but transfer to upstream supplier equities with a multi-day delay due to investor inattention and delayed revenue recognition. Exploiting the decayed customer return signal (ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5)) captures this unpriced economic spillover.
confounders: Customer concentration shifts and supplier contract terminations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns decay to zero when supply chain disclosures become synchronous and automated.
